items.title: Eli Lilly is trouncing Nvidia — and the weight-loss drug trade is beating AI again
items.summary: Since its Oct. 6 record, Nvidia has shed more than $1.7 trillion in market value. Eli Lilly has added more than $250 billion over the same stretch, a gain topped only by Apple among the market's biggest stocks.

items.title: NVO's Hemophilia A Treatment Gets EC Nod, Data Presented on CagriSema
items.summary: Novo secures EC approval for Frehemgo while CagriSema delivers up to 21% weight loss, adding momentum to its turnaround efforts amid intensifying obesity drug competition.

items.title: CVS Sees a Possible Break-Even Point for GLP-1s
items.summary: Drugmakers could gain patients while earning less per prescription.

items.title: CVS white paper aims to pressure drugmakers to lower GLP-1 prices
items.summary: GLP-1s would save employers money in the long term if priced at $350 a month or less, the company found. “I would love to see this pressure [drugmakers] to bring down prices to something rational,” CMO Amy Compton-Phillips said.

items.title: Weight-Loss Drugs for Elementary-Age Children Succeed in Study
items.summary: Novo Nordisk’s study of GLP-1s in children as young as 6 years old worked for shedding pounds but raised questions about growth rates.

items.title: Eli Lilly to acquire Calytrix Bio in deal worth up to $1.5 billion
items.summary: Eli Lilly and Co (NYSE:LLY) has agreed to acquire privately held biotechnology company Calytrix Bio for up to $1.5 billion in cash, expanding its efforts to develop treatments for rare blood disorders and strengthen its presence in haematology. items.title: J&J Stock Rallies More Than 10% in a Month: Time to Buy, Sell or Hold?
items.summary: JNJ's rally reflects stronger earnings and promising drug launches, but MedTech weakness, patent losses and litigation risks remain.

items.title: Eli Lilly to Acquire Calytrix Bio for Up to $1.5 Billion to Expand Blood Cancer Portfolio
items.summary: Eli Lilly and Company (NYSE:LLY) has agreed to acquire privately held biotechnology company Calytrix Bio in a cash transaction valued at up to $1. 5 billion, expanding its development portfolio of treatments for rare blood cancers.
